title: Red Line Tunnel Maintenance (Central - Tech Park)
description: Simulated emergency power inspection on Metro Red Line between Central Station and Tech Park. Forces passengers onto Route 101 bus or multi-line transfers.

title: Port Terminal Bridge Closure (Destination Unreachable)
description: Simulated structural inspection of the Harbor-to-Port viaduct. Port Terminal is a terminus with a single link, demonstrating disconnected network and unreachable destination handling.

title: Old Town Road Works (Bus Route 204)
description: Road resurfacing halts direct bus service between Central Station and Old Town Square. Commuters must transfer through Cultural Center or Financial District.

title: Dual Metro Corridor Maintenance
description: Simulated simultaneous track work on Red Line (Central - Tech Park) and Green Line (Financial - Marina Bay), demonstrating complex rerouting across the network.
